findings.title: HPE Security Bulletin HPESBNW05162 Published October 22, 2026
findings.summary_md: Rescana reports HPE published bulletin HPESBNW05162 on 22 October 2026, fixing 72 vulnerabilities in AOS-8 and AOS-10 wireless operating systems. The headline flaw, CVE-2026-79844, is an authentication bypass in AOS-10 leading to remote code execution. Eight flaws carry CVSS 10.0.

findings.title: The Back Room Tech Reports HPE Patches 72 ArubaOS Vulnerabilities Including Eight CVSS 10.0 Flaws
findings.summary_md: On October 22, 2026, HPE published security bulletin HPESBNW05162 (revision 1), fixing 72 vulnerabilities across AOS-8 and AOS-10. The article notes eight maximum-severity flaws, including authentication bypass and remote code execution vulnerabilities.

findings.title: P.K. Sharma Briefing on HPE Aruba Patches for 72 Flaws
findings.summary_md: The briefing summarizes HPE bulletin HPESBNW05162 covering 72 flaws in ArubaOS (AOS-8 and AOS-10), including eight CVSS 10.0 remote code execution bugs. It references the primary security bulletin and notes the affected wireless operating systems.
